comment: The nemar-cli commit the runner protocol schema is copied from. The schema is written in nemar-cli (shared/contract/compute-runner.schema.json) and copied here byte for byte; whichever repository merges first writes it, the other copies it. The schema refers to the live progress schema by its $id (launcher/schema/compute-progress.v1.json, pinned by tests/contract/nemar-cli-progress-pin.json at the same commit). Bump it deliberately: see docs/contracts.md. CI checks out exactly this commit; tests/contract/test_runner_drift.py compares against it.
